title: Well, That’s Interesting Tech!
author: Scott
description: Exploring ideas and applications of digital technology for good and with purpose. In this podcast I speak with technology leaders who aspire to make the world a better place for all. We talk about what drives them, what they aim to achieve and how their work aligns with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs) Find out more here and get in touch via the website, here 👉 https://wellthatsinteresting.tech

episodes_recents.titre: Scott Interviews Elena Escrivá De Romaní Pérez from FuelVision about reducing aviation emissions.
Graeme Cox talks about understanding human emotions in immersive (VR) environments.
Ben Towers talks about creating connections and tackling social isolation in the workforce.
Angela Baker talks about the social impact and do-good possibility of telecom, wireless and 5G
Aidan McClean and the rise of Electric Vehicle Car Rental
